metric_contract.raw_dv: sum(V_swing - V_take for swings; sign reversed for takes); cumulative runs
metric_contract.dv_per_100: 100 * raw_dv / eligible pitches; runs per 100 pitches
metric_contract.dv_plus: 100 + 15 * (dv_per_100 - qualified mean) / qualified population standard deviation
metric_contract.swing_aggression: 100 * mean(S - p_swing); percentage points, tendency only
metric_contract.za_percentile: midrank percentile among season hitters with at least 300 eligible pitches
metric_contract.region_contributions: 100 * sum(DV in region/action) / ALL eligible player pitches; additive to dv_per_100

data_quality.policy: Unresolved scoring halves are excluded; incomplete innings do not train RE. No invented scoring timestamps.
